# Best Brunch in Chicago
HOME OF THE WORLD FAMOUS FRENCH TOAST FLIGHT
## Best Brunch and Breakfast in Chicago Starts Here
With locations in Lincoln Park, South Loop and Olympia Fields, Batter & Berries brings bold brunch flavor to both the heart of Chicago and the charm of the South Suburbs. Whether you're planning a brunch downtown, scouting a hidden gem in the Chicago suburbs, or just craving our famous French Toast Flight—we've got you.
  

### Chicago Brunch Spots That Hit Every Flavor Note
Try our signature French Toast Flight, packed with rotating seasonal flavors, or dig into our famous Cluck-N-Gaufre—a sweet potato waffle stuffed with fried chicken. Pair it with a mimosa or BYOB option and enjoy a brunch with a view of vibrant Lincoln Park, South Loop or Olympia Fields.
[Learn More about Us](https://www.batterandberries.com/about)
## Now Serving You From 3 Chicago Locations!
South Loop is now open for Dine In!
## Need Breakfast & Brunch Catering in Chicago? We'll Bring the Party to You
From boardrooms to baby showers, Batter & Berries delivers bold brunch flavors straight to your event. Our brunch catering and office catering options make it easy to impress your guests without lifting a spatula. Planning a team breakfast? A weekend celebration? We've got you covered—no buffet line necessary.
[Inquire Now](https://www.batterandberries.com/catering)

# Add Your Review
Thanks for visiting Batter & Berries. We'd love to have your feedback!
Select a location
Select an item
Submit Review
You are submitting your information to Batter & Berries and Popmenu, which powers this site and is sponsoring this giveaway. Popmenu's Giveaway Terms and Privacy Policy apply. 
## Our Latest Reviews
Marilast year
### [Buttermilk Fried Chicken Breast](https://www.batterandberries.com/items/buttermilk-fried-chicken-breast?location=batter-and-berries-olympia-fields&menu=main-menu-ordering)
The chicken is seasoned right and fried perfectly. Always a hit.
Marilast year
### [Caramel French Toast](https://www.batterandberries.com/items/caramel-french-toast?location=batter-and-berries-olympia-fields&menu=main-menu-ordering)
This French toast is amazing! It will, for sure, put you in a food coma.
Jessica2 years ago
### [French Toast Flight](https://www.batterandberries.com/items/french-toast-flight?location=batter-and-berries-lincoln-park&menu=main-menu-ordering)
Batter and Berries is one of the few brunch spots that NEVER DISAPPOINTS. I've taken so many out of towners, and I love the classics plus seasonal options. The flight of French toast is awesome because you can try several. I tell people if they want memorable tasty food, this is the first Chicago choice.
Lovehoodies22 years ago
### [Caramel French Toast](https://www.batterandberries.com/items/caramel-french-toast?location=batter-and-berries-lincoln-park&menu=main-menu-ordering)
Me and my best friend always come her for either her birthday or mine. She always order the Strawberry French Toast. Today is her birthday....The food is always good.
Marilast year
### [Cluck & Gaufre](https://www.batterandberries.com/items/cluck-and-gaufre?location=batter-and-berries-olympia-fields&menu=main-menu-ordering)
This is my favorite dish. You don't need any syrup because the flavor in this dish is so amazing! I order it every time I come.
Nique142last year
### [Strawberry French Toast](https://www.batterandberries.com/items/strawberry-french-toast-2?location=batter-and-berries-lincoln-park&menu=main-menu-ordering)
Absolutely DELICIOUS!!! Light and fluffy with the maple butter and strawberry sauce! We got sides of bacon and they were cooked to perfection! Came back 3 times in 3 days!!!
Markbouie2 years ago
### [Apple Belgique](https://www.batterandberries.com/items/apple-belgique?location=batter-and-berries-olympia-fields&menu=main-menu-ordering)
Service was excellent. Food taste great and came out fast.

# Brunch with Purpose – The Batter & Berries Story
We are open for DINE-IN, Carry-Out, and Delivery!
## Our Story
Established in 2012 by Dr. Tanya & Craig Richardson, who had the desire to add an eclectic world-class restaurant to the vibrant Chicago brunch scene. The idea was simple: offer the freshest food possible with flavors that people would come from all over the world to experience, and want to come back for more. Always a supporter of community and local businesses, we have taken the idea to the next level with cultivated partnerships. We’ve collaborated with several local artisans, craftspeople, and purveyors to provide a uniquely Chicago experience. 
## We’re here for you!
We’re driven by our passion for good food and people and are here for your service. We simply want to provide you with delicious food, a fun and uplifting atmosphere, and serve you with joy. We take great pride in our menu consisting of freshly prepared items (yes, we crack our own eggs & shred the potatoes daily) and collaborations with other local artisans, purveyors & craftspeople for a truly unique experience.
  

**We’re Open for Dine-In, Delivery & Take-Out Tuesday, Wednesday, & Thursday 9:00am-2:00pm AND Friday-Monday 8:00am- 3:00pm**
## Meet The Family
![Dr. Tanya Richardson](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D600%2Cheight%3D600%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/9c017ae3-7b22-449a-8cc5-df765c34259f.jpg)
### Dr. Tanya Richardson 
#### (The Doc)
Founder & Owner
Born and raised In Chicago, Dr. Richardson believes in giving people the best experience possible. She is the creative force behind the bright floral decor, hand-crafted tables, and artwork selections.
![Craig Richardson ](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D600%2Cheight%3D600%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/783ef562-e1fc-45d3-8496-4d3f1e5b70b2.jpg)
## Craig Richardson 
### (The Que)
Managing Owner
Known as “The Que” to outsiders, to us, he is “Mr. Happy”. Always wearing something purple, you can sometimes catch him dining, conversing with guests, or ensuring things run smoothly. His motto is that we are in the “happy people business,” and he aims to provide his guests with world-class customer service!
![Ken L. Polk](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D600%2Cheight%3D600%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/77f7b68b-250b-4a76-bcc8-facb9c7f2810.jpg)
## Ken L. Polk 
### (The Chef)
A Chicago native son and consummate foodie with Southern roots, Northern flair, and global experiences. He brings over 25 years of culinary expertise to the B&B kitchen. His passion is food and serving people the best, most flavorful food possible.

![logo](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width=1920,height=1920,format=auto,fit=scale-down/gdrljfwu/6eabd937-5e7f-4445-9df8-dbdab54d33ab.png)
## HOME OF THE WORLD FAMOUS FRENCH TOAST FLIGHT
[Order Now](https://www.batterandberries.com/popmenu-order)
![logo](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D600%2Cheight%3D600%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/9c315891-9a4e-4d78-8108-109d22ccbef5.png)
Batter & Berries was founded by Dr. Tanya & Craig Richardson in 2012 as an eclectic breakfast, lunch, and brunch restaurant. The purpose was simple: provide a world-class dining experience like no other. We have done just that by providing guests with unique food options and an upbeat & invigorating atmosphere.
What makes us special is our approach to serving you, our guests; we serve you the way we want to be served, with love. Most of our menu items are made in-house each day. Every egg is cracked by hand, our sausages are hand-made from locally sourced poultry and maple Leaf Farms Pork, and our potatoes are shredded fresh daily. We use 100% Pure Maple Syrup, nothing artificial. Our French Toast batters and sauces are made with fresh fruit, which leaves an unmistakable impression on the palate.
Batter & Berries is a melting pot and community hub. We also are very proud to partner with other local artisans, craftspeople, and businesses to further provide selections you simply won’t get anywhere else. Collaborations include; La Colombe Coffee Roasters, Burnt City Brewing, Delilah’s Bar, Love Cork Screw, Brown Sugar Bakery, Noir D’ Ebene Patisserie, CCap, After School Matters, Chicago Public Schools Culinary Arts, to name a few. Simply put, we love what we do here and hope you will too!
  

**We’re here for you!**
  

[LINCOLN AVENUE MENU](https://www.batterandberries.com/menu-lincoln-ave) [OLYMPIA FIELDS MENU](https://www.batterandberries.com/menu-olympia-fields)
## Catering
Elevate your events with our expert catering services. From intimate gatherings to grand celebrations, our customizable menus and professional staff will make sure every detail is taken care of. We're here for you!
[Inquire Now](https://www.batterandberries.com/catering)
## Now Serving You From 3 Locations!
South Loop is only available for online ordering currently!
## You can order online and write a review
Review us on Yelp!
[Review Us](https://www.yelp.com/biz/batter-and-berries-chicago?show_waitlist_notify_me=True)

# FAQ
frequently asked questions
## When are we actually open?
Our hours of operation are Friday-Monday, 8:00 A.M. until 3:00 P.M CST, and 9:00 A.M. until 2:00 P.M. Tuesday-Thursday unless otherwise stated.  
  

## Do you take reservations?
No, we do not take reservations; we are a “first-come, first-served” establishment. However, we do have a waitlist that your party can be placed on via our website. Any member of your party can put you on the list with a name and contact info.  
  

## How does “the list” work?
Once your name is on the list, you will receive an initial text. Once we are ready to seat you, there will be a second text. After the second text is sent, you will have up to 10 minutes for your complete party to be present in the restaurant for us to proceed. As a general policy, we do not sit incomplete parties or allow late joiners. This helps to decrease wait times and speed service along.
## Alcohol
Our Lincoln Park location in Chicago is a BYOB establishment with restrictions. We card everyone at the table before any alcohol is opened (no pre-opened bottles of any kind are allowed for health code compliance). Any juices need to be purchased from us, as outside juices are not allowed.  
  
Our Olympia Fields location is NOT a BYOB establishment but does have a full-service bar.   
Have a Mimosa Flight with your French Toast Flight!
## What about Parking?
There is street parking available on Lincoln Ave and surrounding streets. Please read the signs and do not park in the loading zones on Lincoln; you will be ticketed. The meters are $2.00/hour, M-Sat. On Sunday, the meters are free.   
  
The Olympia Fields location has FREE parking.
## What should I expect?
We provide an upbeat and fun environment with handmade tables, Sunshine Yellow walls, and garden-themed decor to brighten your day. You never know who will be in the restaurant on a given day. We often have A-Listers dine in, including; professional athletes, Grammy-winning musicians, Oscar, Tony & Emmy award-winning actors, and producers, not to mention people from all walks of life. You’re in for a treat.
## What’s that music playing?
The music in the background is Classic Chicago House Music. That is the only music we play; we’re househeads!
## How often does the French toast change?
Our signature French Toast flavors ( strawberry, lemon, blueberry & caramel) will not change. Our special flavor changes every week and is available three ways: full order, half order, or with the SuperFlight.
## What about the Specials?
While the regular menu may change 1-2 times annually, the Specials Board is subject to change at any time. We try to provide you with a familiar experience yet give you fresh and creative options to choose from. Items may be seasonal, limited editions, or even flash items (one day only) based on how Chef is inspired. So check social media often, call, or come in and see what’s new and exciting.
## Do you have merch?
Yes, we have merchandise for sale in-store. We have hats, shirts, and Champagne flutes!
## Next Location?
Please believe that we are diligently searching for our next location. We are looking for the right mix (location, location, location) that will allow us to thrive for years to come, as well as deliver the world-class experience you have come to know and love.

# Taste the World-Famous French Toast at Batter & Berries
World famous… Really?
Since day one, our French Toast Flight has had foodies talking—from Chicago to Tokyo, Paris to Portland. Batter & Berries' legendary French Toast is more than a menu item. It's a movement. And yes—it really is world famous.
![map](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D600%2Cheight%3D600%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/75f3879b-f685-4cd6-9ef3-771ffdac694f.jpg)
## We have had guests from all over the World as well as All of the continental United States, as well as Hawaii & U.S. Territories.
## Where in the world you ask?
We are both proud and honored to have had guests visit us from the following countries, states, kingdoms and territories:

Just to name a few!!!
![The Original French Toast Flight](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D1200%2Cheight%3D1200%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/72fc3144-4950-4509-a909-c02ff7588f77.webp)
## The Original French Toast Flight
Each week our Special French Toast changes; while some toasts are repeats, new flavors are given a new number! The other Chef Specials are created to highlight seasonal, cultural, or other preparations and are subject to availability!
![Champagne](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D1200%2Cheight%3D1200%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/4b3f6454-1f17-4309-b46a-801628627626.jpeg)
## Champagne French Toast!
Champagne and White chocolate battered French Toast topped with Champagne Cremé , Caramel sauce and Gold Sequins!!  
  
Happy 2024!
![waffle](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D1200%2Cheight%3D1200%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/bf317bbb-42f3-42a8-87bb-dd1447c227f6.webp)
## Breakfast
Breakfast is our claim to fame! With our World Famous French Toast Flight, which combines our four signature flavors of batter-dipped Brioche, you will surely find your favorite! We also make things from scratch around these parts, with our hand-shredded B&B Cheese Crusted Hash Browns, house-made B&B Maple Chicken & Apple, or B&B Spicy Pork sausage; you can taste the Love!  
  

![lunch](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D1200%2Cheight%3D1200%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/90f64ff9-1e95-48e9-a414-0d4ee5ca87bc.webp)
## Lunch
We also have an eclectic mix of menu items featuring collaborations with local specialty artisans, including; La Colombe Coffee, Delilah’s Chicago Bar, Burnt City Brewing, and Love Cork Screw Wine
![brunch](https://popmenucloud.com/cdn-cgi/image/width%3D1200%2Cheight%3D1200%2Cfit%3Dscale-down%2Cformat%3Dauto%2Cquality%3D60/gdrljfwu/c502267b-a5a0-4ec9-852f-2e685d705f3b.webp)
## Brunch
Brunch at Batter & Berries is like none other! With items like our French Toast Flight, Cluck & Gaufre (goof), La Colombe Brisket, or The PortaBella Hash, there is something for everyone to love!
